split_strategy: School-stratified 80/20 (FINAL-5.0): per-school stratified split, pooled. Schools contributing to test: 0/12. Fallback global split used: True.

leakage_guard.note: Identical A_Q1..A_Q10 patterns across DIFFERENT children are natural clinical overlap in a 10-item screener — NOT leakage. Only participant ID uniqueness is enforced.

architecture_notes.split_strategy: School-stratified 80/20 (FINAL-5.0). Each school independently split; schools unable to contribute send all to dev. Fallback to global stratified 80/20 if no school can contribute.
architecture_notes.leakage_prevention: Participant ID uniqueness enforced. Identical AQ-10 patterns across different children are NOT leakage.
architecture_notes.cv_strategy: 5-fold StratifiedKFold on train set, sealed once in Phase 0. Identical fold assignments for all 5 algorithms.
architecture_notes.threshold_protocol: Decision threshold fixed at 0.50, pre-specified in Phase 0. No Youden's J or post-hoc threshold selection.
architecture_notes.final_model_protocol: M* (champion) retrained on FULL train set with best HPs from CV. Evaluated exactly once on locked test set.
architecture_notes.bootstrap_protocol: Stratified bootstrap preserving original class counts, 2000 iterations, 95% percentile CI. No BCa correction.
architecture_notes.no_modeling_in_phase0: No scaling, SMOTE, feature selection, or threshold tuning. All transforms applied only inside CV fold training sets.
architecture_notes.rq2_note: For LOSO (RQ2): lock the algorithm + hyperparameters + threshold from RQ1. Retrain a FRESH model inside each LOSO fold — do NOT reuse the joblib model trained on all dev data.
